objective: LungVision AI — Phase 5C Independent Reproduction, Generalization & Scientific Integrity Audit.
acceptance_criteria: Task A: Prediction Independence Audit (Investigate why mean SSM, frontal-only, lateral-only, and dual-view concatenation report nearly identical baseline results; record prediction tensors, mesh hashes, predicted PCA coefficients, coefficient variance across patients, and pairwise distances; detect untrained models, fallback predictions, and unintended mean-shape collapse; export phase5c_prediction_independence_audit.json).

Task B: Full Evaluation Reproduction (Independently recompute patient-level ASSD, HD95, Surface Dice at 1/2/3/5mm, total and bilateral volume errors, and uncertainty calibration across all 65 held-out patients; export phase5c_patient_level_metrics.csv and phase5c_reproduction_metrics.json).

Task C: Oracle and SSM Analysis (Verify oracle CT projection coefficient math b* = E^T (s - s_mean); distinguish oracle projection, mean-shape baseline, frontal-only, lateral-only, and dual-view attention/V2 models; verify training-only PCA fitting and coordinate consistency; export phase5c_oracle_verification.json).

Task D: Statistical Validation & Reanalysis (Recompute paired comparisons on patient-level differences; audit Wilcoxon signed-rank statistic, W+=0, ties, exact vs asymptotic p-values, paired bootstrap 95% CIs [10,000 resamples], effect sizes r_rb and Cohen's dz, and Holm-Bonferroni correction; export phase5c_statistical_reanalysis.json).

Task E: Generalization & Data Leakage Audit (Inspect entire data pipeline for patient overlap, duplicate scans, registration leakage, test-informed preprocessing, and checkpoint selection; export phase5c_data_leakage_audit.json).

Task F: Uncertainty Calibration Audit (Evaluate heteroscedastic log-variance uncertainty against true surface errors; report Spearman correlation, calibration curves, bin coverage, and failure detection AUROC; export phase5c_uncertainty_calibration.json).

Task G: Anatomical & Coordinate Validation (Verify DICOM LPS/RAS conventions, left/right and superior/inferior orientation, normal vectors, bilateral separation, physical mm spacing, and Divergence Theorem signed volumetry; export phase5c_anatomical_coordinate_audit.json).

Task H: Reproducibility Manifest & Authoritative Report (Create clean reproduction command, record git commit, package versions, checkpoint SHA-256 digests, seeds, and hardware; export phase5c_reproducibility_manifest.json and PHASE_5C_INDEPENDENT_VALIDATION_REPORT.md with authoritative verdict).
non_goals: Do not modify or retrain frozen DenseNet121 production weights (SHA-256: 8d3690cd0438587a94afb8fd2ad84c0b30f9c1cc2727ee0eb03662a02ea020af)
Do not alter frozen NIH production classification thresholds
Do not overwrite Phase 5B results or delete datasets/checkpoints
Do not fabricate missing results or silently replace failed experiments
Do not claim clinical validity — surfaces are estimated anatomical reconstructions, not diagnostic CT scans
